title: Growing letter billboard

location.series: JKR / Burger King identity case study

slide_intent: Let type scale carry the message so a simple phrase can communicate intensity at a distance.
strategic_value: An expanding run of letters can turn Burger King’s appetite language into a memorable roadside graphic.
demonstration: A long cream billboard shows red M forms increasing from small at left to large at right, with Juicy and the logo at the end.
practical_value: Compare directional changes in scale as a way to use an unusually wide format.

content_islands.name: Letter progression
content_islands.spec: Run the repeated red M shapes across the billboard, increasing their height toward the right.

content_islands.name: Closing cue
content_islands.spec: Place vertical Juicy text and the small signature at the right edge.

content_islands.name: Street context
content_islands.spec: Retain the fence, road and buildings to show environmental scale.

reference_purposes.Application: The type progression is applied to an elongated outdoor billboard.
reference_purposes.Expression: Increasing letter size gives a visual crescendo to an appetite sound.
